findings: Resolver staging hazard (caution, not blocker): _result_bundle_for returns the legacy top-level probes/047/results_v2 unconditionally, BEFORE the contract-match logic, contradicting its own S2c comment that the legacy name is the fallback. Because the subset check requires the staged bundle's directory name to be 'results_v2' (expected_source_dir = probes/047/{bundle.name}), staging the 17-file bundle at the natural in-repo path probes/047/results_v2 and leaving it there would make interpret-build resolve the uncommitted staging tree instead of the receipt-bound import at probes/047/results/results_v2-dc586665d0be. Stage the bundle outside the repository (any parent dir with the directory named results_v2 satisfies the subset check), and run the packet's mandated resolver verification after import with no legacy path present.

Resolver contract precondition (caution): contract-match selection requires _contract_hash(ideas/047) to equal dc586665d0bece940d1a1f4b3b0572f8c951c2ba; otherwise discovery falls back to name/lexicographic-newest and interpret-build's validate_bundle is the only backstop (it fails closed). The verification step should explicitly confirm the current contract hash equals dc586665..., not only that the returned path matches.

interpret_review = "claude" in AGENTS.toml is decorative: interpret_build derives the reviewer as the family opposite roles.interpret and never reads the interpret_review key. Currently consistent (codex authors, claude reviews), but a future edit to roles.interpret alone would silently change the reviewer family while the config still claims otherwise. Suggestion: note this in the config comment or have interpret_build assert agreement.

Reviewer write-scope is prompt-enforced only: _check_scope runs after the interpret leg but not after interpret_review, and the claude command allows Write/Edit with --permission-mode acceptEdits, so 'modify no file other than interpret_review.md' relies on the prompt. Mitigated by per-round _commit_all making any tampering visible in the diff and by supervised operation; acceptable for this run.

Privacy/egress is environmental, not enforced (caution): both legs run network-capable over private case-level metadata (codex sandbox_workspace_write.network_access=true; claude has WebSearch, WebFetch and Bash(git:*)). The 'no remotes, no publication route' invariant does not technically prevent git remote add + push if any ambient credential helper exists, and network tools could leak bundle contents. Before invocation, confirm SCOUT_CI/ANTHROPIC_API_KEY unset as documented and that no GitHub credential is reachable from the checkout; supervised execution and the stated no-remote clone make this acceptable for this run.

Fail-closed boundaries verified in supplied source: operative publication.json remains blocked pending the operator decision; record-result enforces policy contract match, ancestry marker binding dc586665..., immutable destination, and (via publication_subset.verify) exactly-one-disposition coverage of all 215 source files, staged/-only exclusions with byte-bound private evidence, and required-audit-files-retained — matching requested decision 1. Ratification is ordered after import in both the packet and the execution sequence.

Authority and provenance preserved: the packet keeps all three actions explicitly PREPARED_NOT_APPROVED under one named decision ID with reserved gates (public release, merges, reruns, contract changes, unattended activation) intact; Phase-A outputs were moved with recorded SHA-256s rather than deleted, which both prevents stale files satisfying the new run's output-existence checks and makes --resume-review fail closed (no interpretation.md to review); Phase-A approvals/receipts remain in git history and the private manifest. Model identity is pinned with no fallback and allow_api_billing=false, so model unavailability is a named stop rather than a silent substitution. The identical determinism_manifest_start/end hashes in the retained set are consistent with the deterministic-procedure uncertainty rule in the revised interpret prompt.

Minor: record_result contains a redundant 'if policy_path.exists():' immediately after raising when it does not exist — harmless; and the interpret prompt's decisions.md append is deliberately deferred (round-1 restriction plus 'Human ratification of the decision entry remains yours'), so no automatic decision-registry write occurs without the human gate.
